method: Independent actual web opening of seven primary official URLs and targeted reading of the cited legal/informational passages. These are the reviewer's bounded paraphrases. No original full text, PDF, learner data or third-party license transfer is stored.

readings.title: European Commission: EU-Canada agreements
readings.readLocation: CETA provisional application/status and dated timeline
readings.ownFinding: The official page records provisional application on 21 September 2017 and separates it from full entry into force after the required ratifications. The candidate truthfully avoids claiming that every chapter is fully effective.
readings.decision: KEEP bounded status/date aid; no full treaty legal certification

readings.title: Council: CETA origin and origin-procedures protocol
readings.ownFinding: Origin covers wholly obtained goods, exclusively originating materials and sufficient production under the protocol conditions. Dispatch from a party alone does not establish it. Missing necessary origin evidence leaves the candidate A2 preference entitlement unproved.
readings.decision: KEEP scoped origin explanation; not every product-specific origin rule is reproduced

readings.title: European Commission: CETA explained
readings.readLocation: Standards, conformity assessment and smaller businesses; technical-standard paragraphs around rendered lines 156-212
readings.ownFinding: Product requirements remain. Recognition of conformity assessment can reduce duplicate testing under covered conditions, not abolish all tests or standards. The candidate states this limit and treats its shipment-documentation amounts as fictional teaching inputs.

readings.title: Council treaty register: EU-Japan Economic Partnership Agreement
readings.ownFinding: The official register explicitly gives 1 February 2019 as the entry-into-force date. This is the dated status used in both candidate language versions.

readings.title: European Commission: Export info for Japanese businesses
readings.readLocation: Tariff preferences, origin statement and technical/food requirements; rendered tariff/origin/requirements paragraphs
readings.ownFinding: The Japanese-exporter information fits the model's Japan-to-EU trade direction. Preferences require origin qualification and proof; technical and food requirements continue. The candidate does not present fictional tariffs, prices or fixed costs as actual tariff-line facts.
readings.decision: KEEP scoped preference/origin/protection aid; no product-specific customs advice

readings.title: ECB: What is money?
readings.readLocation: How is money created?, rendered lines 72-76; page update 19 June 2024
readings.ownFinding: The actual current explanation distinguishes central-bank reserves from commercial-bank money and links loan creation to bank balance expansion and repayment to disappearance of the created money. It supports the fictional paired-principal transactions with interest and fees expressly excluded.

readings.title: Philip R. Lane, 20 March 2025: The digital euro: maintaining the autonomy of the monetary system
readings.readLocation: Existing monetary system/two-layer architecture: rendered lines 59, 63-80
readings.ownFinding: The official speech describes customer cross-bank payment settlement through the payer bank's reserve debit and recipient bank's reserve credit, as well as loan-created borrower deposits. The candidate distinguishes settlement reserves, deposits and credit claims without treating bank liquidity/capital assumptions as unlimited real lending.
readings.decision: KEEP scoped existing-payment-system explanation; no digital-euro prediction is assessed

actualModelLimits: Agreement identity, application status and cited qualitative rules are real; prices, quantities, duty amounts and documentation costs are explicitly fictional.

Production offers in B are expressly equated to real production resource costs, making the model's resource-costly supplier switch interpretable as diversion. Tariff receipts are transfers, not production resource use.
No actual preference-use, employment, consumer-price or worldwide-welfare measurement is supplied or claimed.
Bank balances are fictional; adequate settlement reserves and capital/risk compliance are explicit assumptions. Interest, fees, cash, tax and other transactions are excluded.
These seven source readings qualify new material explanations; they do not reopen or substitute for previously independently qualified curricular source mappings or country/course scope evidence.
